user.title: Create Forecast Helper
user.description: Create a forecast helper. For Battery SOC select the measured battery percentage; its solar, load and battery settings follow. History days applies to Historical Shift.

data_description.history_days: Number of days of history to fetch and shift forward (1-30)
data_description.source_entity: The sensor entity to generate a forecast for

battery_soc.title: Configure Battery SOC
battery_soc.description: Forecast household self-consumption from existing HA entities. Runs in the background every five minutes and when core inputs change. Records the prediction one hour ahead for comparison. Optional migration preserves the old sensor and its history, then removes the standalone helper. Amber/VPP dispatch is not predicted.

data.migrate_existing: Migrate existing SOC helper and retain its history

data_description.capacity_entity: Choose a native capacity sensor, or set the capacity override below.
data_description.charge_efficiency: Effective stored-energy/SOC gain from available solar surplus. Calibrate for your battery.
data_description.charge_power_entity: Choose a native charging rating, or set the charging override below.
data_description.discharge_overhead_kw: Additional battery-side consumption while supplying load; defaults to zero.
data_description.discharge_power_entity: Choose a native discharging rating, or set the discharging override below.
data_description.solar_forecast_factor: Site-specific correction applied only inside this SOC forecast. Provider entities are not modified.

multiweek.title: Configure Multiweek Average
multiweek.description: Average comparable hours over several weeks. Fewer than three comparable days fall back to last week when available.

data_description.day_grouping: Group working days and weekends together, or learn each weekday separately (requires at least 3 weeks).
data_description.forecast_days: How many days ahead to forecast.
data_description.history_weeks: Use completed hourly observations from the preceding 2–12 weeks.
